headline: Issued compliance certificate and two orders of conditions, continued two hearings, and approved delineation policy
summary: The Commission handled certificates of compliance, several notices of intent, and other business for various properties. It issued a certificate of compliance for 12 Fosters Point, closed hearings for 15 Wirling Drive and 8 Upland Road, and continued hearings for 58 West Street and 40 Prince Street. It also issued orders of conditions for 15 Wirling Drive and 8 Upland Road, approved a Delineation Policy, approved MACC membership dues, and approved prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Issued a Complete Certificate of Compliance for 12 Fosters Point, DEP File #5-283, including perpetual condition #5, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 58 West Street, DEP File #5-1472 to July 28, 2026, 4-0.
Closed the hearing for 15 Wirling Drive, DEP File #5-1471, 4-0.
Closed the hearing for 8 Upland Road, DEP File #5-1473, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 40 Prince Street, DEP File #5-1474 to July 28, 2026, 5-0.
Approved the Delineation Policy as discussed, 5-0.
Approved payment of MACC Membership dues of $847, 5-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 15 Wirling Drive, DEP File #5-1471, with special conditions, 4-0-1 (Redmond abstains).
Issued an Order of Conditions for 8 Upland Road, DEP File #5-1473, with special conditions, 4-0-1 (Redmond abstains).
Approved the meeting minutes of June 9, 2026, as presented, 5-0.
